title: पञ्चसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Damayanti swears that the svayamvara was only a ruse to find him, and the Wind, the Sun and the Moon bear witness to her purity from the sky. Nala puts on the serpent's garment, regains his true form, and the two are joyfully united.
summary.kn: ಸ್ವಯಂವರ ಅವನನ್ನು ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿಯುವ ಉಪಾಯ ಮಾತ್ರ ಎಂದು ದಮಯಂತಿ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾಳೆ; ವಾಯು, ಸೂರ್ಯ, ಚಂದ್ರರು ಆಕಾಶದಿಂದ ಅವಳ ಪಾವಿತ್ರ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸಾಕ್ಷಿ ನುಡಿಯುತ್ತಾರೆ. ನಳನು ಸರ್ಪದ ವಸ್ತ್ರ ಧರಿಸಿ ನಿಜರೂಪ ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಇಬ್ಬರೂ ಹರ್ಷದಿಂದ ಒಂದಾಗುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: दमयन्ती शपथ लेती हैं कि स्वयंवर उन्हें खोजने का केवल एक उपाय था, और वायु, सूर्य और चन्द्रमा आकाश से उनकी पवित्रता की साक्षी देते हैं। नल नाग का दिया वस्त्र पहनकर अपना असली रूप पाते हैं, और दोनों हर्ष से मिलते हैं।
summary.te: స్వయంవరం అతనిని కనుగొనడానికి ఒక ఉపాయం మాత్రమేనని దమయంతి ప్రమాణం చేస్తుంది; వాయువు, సూర్యుడు, చంద్రుడు ఆకాశం నుండి ఆమె పవిత్రతకు సాక్ష్యం చెబుతారు. నలుడు సర్పమిచ్చిన వస్త్రం ధరించి నిజరూపం పొందుతాడు, ఇద్దరూ ఆనందంగా కలుస్తారు.
summary.ta: ஸ்வயம்வரம் அவனைக் கண்டுபிடிக்கும் உபாயம் மட்டுமே என்று தமயந்தி சத்தியம் செய்ய, காற்றும் சூரியனும் சந்திரனும் வானிலிருந்து அவள் தூய்மைக்குச் சாட்சி கூறுகிறார்கள். நளன் நாகம் தந்த ஆடையை அணிந்து உண்மை உருவம் பெற, இருவரும் மகிழ்வுடன் இணைகிறார்கள்.
summary.ml: സ്വയംവരം നളനെ കണ്ടെത്താനുള്ള ഒരു കൗശലമായിരുന്നുവെന്ന് ദമയന്തി ശപഥം ചെയ്യുന്നു; അവളുടെ ശുദ്ധിക്ക് വായുവും സൂര്യനും ചന്ദ്രനും ആകാശത്തുനിന്ന് സാക്ഷ്യം നൽകുന്നു. നളൻ സർപ്പം നൽകിയ വസ്ത്രം അണിഞ്ഞ് തന്റെ യഥാർത്ഥ രൂപം വീണ്ടെടുക്കുന്നു; ഇരുവരും സന്തോഷത്തോടെ ഒന്നാകുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.75; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: दमयन्त्युवाच

meaning.en: Damayanti said:

verses.text:
न मामर्हसि कल्याण पापेन परिशङ्कितुम् ।
मया हि देवानुत्सृज्य वृतस्त्वं निषधाधिप ॥

meaning.en: Noble one, you should not suspect me of wrongdoing. Lord of Nishadha, I rejected the gods and chose you.

verses.text:
तवाभिगमनार्थं तु सर्वतो ब्राह्मणा गताः ।
वाक्यानि मम गाथाभिर्गायमाना दिशो दश ॥

meaning.en: To bring you here, brahmins went out in every direction, singing my words in verses through all ten quarters.

verses.text:
ततस्त्वां ब्राह्मणो विद्वान्पर्णादो नाम पार्थिव ।
अभ्यगच्छत्कोसलायामृतुपर्णनिवेशने ॥

meaning.en: Then the learned brahmin named Parnada, O king, reached you at Rituparna's house in Kosala.

verses.text:
तेन वाक्ये हृते सम्यक्प्रतिवाक्ये तथाहृते ।
उपायोऽयं मया दृष्टो नैषधानयने तव ॥

meaning.en: When he had carried my message and brought back your reply, I saw this plan for bringing the lord of Nishadha here.

verses.text:
त्वामृते न हि लोकेऽन्य एकाह्ना पृथिवीपते ।
समर्थो योजनशतं गन्तुमश्वैर्नराधिप ॥

meaning.en: For no one in the world but you, O lord of the earth, can drive a hundred yojanas with horses in a single day.

verses.text:
तथा चेमौ महीपाल भजेऽहं चरणौ तव ।
यथा नासत्कृतं किंचिन्मनसापि चराम्यहम् ॥

meaning.en: O king, I hold your feet, I swear that I have never done any wrong, even in thought.

verses.text:
अयं चरति लोकेऽस्मिन्भूतसाक्षी सदागतिः ।
एष मुञ्चतु मे प्राणान्यदि पापं चराम्यहम् ॥

meaning.en: Let the Wind, who moves always through this world as witness to all beings, take my life if I have done wrong.

verses.text:
तथा चरति तिग्मांशुः परेण भुवनं सदा ।
स विमुञ्चतु मे प्राणान्यदि पापं चराम्यहम् ॥

meaning.en: Let the Sun with his sharp rays, who ever travels beyond the world, take my life if I have done wrong.

verses.text:
चन्द्रमाः सर्वभूतानामन्तश्चरति साक्षिवत् ।
स विमुञ्चतु मे प्राणान्यदि पापं चराम्यहम् ॥

meaning.en: Let the Moon, who moves within all beings like a witness, take my life if I have done wrong.

verses.text:
एते देवास्त्रयः कृत्स्नं त्रैलोक्यं धारयन्ति वै ।
विब्रुवन्तु यथासत्यमेते वाद्य त्यजन्तु माम् ॥

meaning.en: These three gods uphold the whole of the three worlds. Let them tell the truth, or else abandon me today.

verses.text:
एवमुक्ते ततो वायुरन्तरिक्षादभाषत ।
नैषा कृतवती पापं नल सत्यं ब्रवीमि ते ॥

meaning.en: When she had spoken, Vayu called from the sky, "Nala, she has done no wrong. I tell you the truth.

verses.text:
राजञ्शीलनिधिः स्फीतो दमयन्त्या सुरक्षितः ।
साक्षिणो रक्षिणश्चास्या वयं त्रीन्परिवत्सरान् ॥

meaning.en: King, Damayanti has guarded a great treasure of good conduct. We have been her witnesses and protectors for three years.

verses.text:
उपायो विहितश्चायं त्वदर्थमतुलोऽनया ।
न ह्येकाह्ना शतं गन्ता त्वदृतेऽन्यः पुमानिह ॥

meaning.en: She has devised this unmatched plan for your sake, for no man but you could go a hundred yojanas in a day.

verses.text:
उपपन्ना त्वया भैमी त्वं च भैम्या महीपते ।
नात्र शङ्का त्वया कार्या संगच्छ सह भार्यया ॥

meaning.en: Bhaimi has you, and you have Bhaimi, O king. You need have no doubt about this; be reunited with your wife."

verses.text:
तथा ब्रुवति वायौ तु पुष्पवृष्टिः पपात ह ।
देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुर्ववौ च पवनः शिवः ॥

meaning.en: As Vayu spoke, a shower of flowers fell, the gods' drums sounded, and an auspicious breeze blew.

verses.text:
तदद्भुततमं दृष्ट्वा नलो राजाथ भारत ।
दमयन्त्यां विशङ्कां तां व्यपाकर्षदरिंदमः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing this great wonder, O Bharata, King Nala, destroyer of foes, drove away his suspicion of Damayanti.

verses.text:
ततस्तद्वस्त्रमरजः प्रावृणोद्वसुधाधिपः ।
संस्मृत्य नागराजानं ततो लेभे वपुः स्वकम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the king put on the clean garment, remembered the serpent king Karkotaka, and regained his own form.

verses.text:
स्वरूपिणं तु भर्तारं दृष्ट्वा भीमसुता तदा ।
प्राक्रोशदुच्चैरालिङ्ग्य पुण्यश्लोकमनिन्दिता ॥

meaning.en: Seeing her husband in his true form, Bhima's blameless daughter cried out loudly and embraced Nala of holy fame.

verses.text:
भैमीमपि नलो राजा भ्राजमानो यथा पुरा ।
सस्वजे स्वसुतौ चापि यथावत्प्रत्यनन्दत ॥

meaning.en: King Nala, shining as before, embraced Bhaimi, and he also fondly welcomed his two children as was fitting.

verses.text:
ततः स्वोरसि विन्यस्य वक्त्रं तस्य शुभानना ।
परीता तेन दुःखेन निशश्वासायतेक्षणा ॥

meaning.en: Then the fair-faced, long-eyed woman pressed her face to his chest and sighed, overcome by that sorrow.

verses.text:
तथैव मलदिग्धाङ्गी परिष्वज्य शुचिस्मिता ।
सुचिरं पुरुषव्याघ्रं तस्थौ साश्रुपरिप्लुता ॥

meaning.en: Likewise, her body smeared with dirt, the sweetly smiling lady held that tiger among men for a long time, drenched in tears.

verses.text:
ततः सर्वं यथावृत्तं दमयन्त्या नलस्य च ।
भीमायाकथयत्प्रीत्या वैदर्भ्या जननी नृप ॥

meaning.en: Then Damayanti's mother, O king, joyfully told Bhima everything that had happened to Damayanti and Nala.

verses.text:
ततोऽब्रवीन्महाराजः कृतशौचमहं नलम् ।
दमयन्त्या सहोपेतं काल्यं द्रष्टा सुखोषितम् ॥

meaning.en: The great king said, "Tomorrow I will see Nala, after he has bathed and rested happily, together with Damayanti."

verses.text:
ततस्तौ सहितौ रात्रिं कथयन्तौ पुरातनम् ।
वने विचरितं सर्वमूषतुर्मुदितौ नृप ॥

meaning.en: Then the two, together, spent the night happily, telling each other all that had happened in the past and their wanderings in the forest.

verses.text:
स चतुर्थे ततो वर्षे संगम्य सह भार्यया ।
सर्वकामैः सुसिद्धार्थो लब्धवान्परमां मुदम् ॥

meaning.en: In the fourth year, having met his wife again, with all his wishes fulfilled and his aim achieved, Nala gained the highest joy.

verses.text:
दमयन्त्यपि भर्तारमवाप्याप्यायिता भृशम् ।
अर्धसंजातसस्येव तोयं प्राप्य वसुंधरा ॥

meaning.en: Damayanti too, having regained her husband, was greatly refreshed, as the earth is when rain reaches a half-grown crop.

verses.text:
सैवं समेत्य व्यपनीततन्द्री
शान्तज्वरा हर्षविवृद्धसत्त्वा ।
रराज भैमी समवाप्तकामा
शीतांशुना रात्रिरिवोदितेन ॥

meaning.en: Thus reunited, her weariness gone, her fever cooled and her spirit swelling with joy, Bhaimi shone, her desires fulfilled, like night when the cool-rayed moon has risen.
